featured_reviews.review_text: Good service and host was professional in giving me the car + Extending my trip for 1 hour at the last minute....but I had a weird experience where I was charged a challan at Goa check point for not carrying my documents where-in I had my documents (provided by the car rental) via whatsapp, and nobody physicallly checked my documents at the goa checkpoint....I was told by the car rental that there will be a dispute raised by the car owner but haven't seen any response on the booking done 5th April. I also tried to get the image proof on Mparivahan but the car was registered undersomeone else who I wasnt dealing with and I did not get any proof but only an open challan under my booking. I ended up paying Rs.2500 for an invalid challan. Becareful while you travell and make sure to ask for all the proof on challan (if there is 1 against your booking) and pay only if its valid and if you know your not at fault then decline the payment or ask to dispute it. I also looked up the car details on Mumbai Traffic app and had multiple unpaid Challans for this vehicle so overall not sure was this some type of scam from renting the car or Glitch on traffic application
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Thank you Vijay Sir for your review, I have already filed a dispute in the Mumbai challan, as soon as I get any update on the challan, I will refund you Rs 2500, and this is not a scam, please do not say so.

They fixed the affected area perfectly, ensuring the bike was back to 100% protection—and they did the entire correction free of charge. This level of commitment to customer satisfaction, even when the fault lies with the customer a month later, is genuinely rare and speaks volumes about their professionalism.

If you are looking for high-quality PPF and a team that stands firmly behind their product with reliable, stress-free aftercare, look no further than Auto Empire. Highly, highly recommended!

featured_reviews.review_text:
Avoid this dealer at all costs.
My experience with this showroom has been extremely disappointing and stressful. I purchased a vehicle here and later discovered serious mechanical problems, including petrol leakage from the carburetor and even a cracked chassis. These are not small issues — they indicate extremely poor maintenance and a complete lack of honesty during the sale.

When I approached the dealer about the problems, there was no proper support, no responsibility, and no respect shown. Instead of helping resolve the issue, they kept avoiding accountability and tried to blame everything on me. I have now been forced to file complaints because of their unprofessional and irresponsible behavior.

This dealer misleads customers, does not disclose the true condition of the vehicle, and shows zero concern for customer safety. Please be very careful before buying anything from this place. Check every document, verify the vehicle thoroughly, and don’t trust their words blindly.

I hope this review helps others avoid the trouble, mental stress, and financial loss I had to go through.
